name: Dadras Attractor
desc: A dense chaotic Dadras attractor woven into a graceful multi-lobed swirling ribbon-knot that tumbles on two incommensurate rotation rates, its density and depth log-mapped from magenta through cyan to white-hot glow on a deep ground.

density.doc: iterate count + brightness (more = denser brighter knot)

hue.doc: palette base hue (audio bloom + seed drift)
